subject.title: fix: prevent LINE channel reloads from hanging on stalled deliveries

question: Should LINE preserve active-delivery ownership until the handler finishes, or should maintainers first sponsor a cross-runtime cancellation/idempotency contract that makes timed reclaim safe?
rationale: The choice changes the accepted at-least-once delivery boundary and cannot be resolved by a local timeout without deciding what duplicate external side effects are permitted.

options.title: Retain ownership until settlement
options.body: Restore the existing unbounded active-delivery wait and pursue a separately designed cancellation capability before allowing reclaim.

options.title: Adopt a cancellation contract first
options.body: Define and validate a core cancellation or idempotent-delivery acknowledgement that prevents the old handler from producing output before the replacement reclaims work.

recommendation.title: Retain ownership until settlement
recommendation.body: Restore the existing unbounded active-delivery wait and pursue a separately designed cancellation capability before allowing reclaim.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same LINE shutdown surface documents the precise ownership constraint and its intended removal condition.
